audit.notes: Originally published 2007-06-21 in Web Enhancement 1 article p2 (supplied Core PDF p290); later reproduced Starships printed p17 (PDF p18). This is NOT the Tech Specialist feat nor an extra slotted modification.

display.summary: As a standard action tune a powered weapon you wield; for rest of encounter gain +1 equipment attack and +2 equipment damage with that weapon only.

registry.rule: Talented standard-action weapon tuning, not a permanent Scum slot upgrade or Tech Specialist feat benefit.

registry.note: Source specifies neither fabrication credits nor a Mechanics check.

prerequisites: Actor has Personalized Modifications Outlaw Tech talent
Powered weapon requiring a power cell or connected to a larger power source
Actor currently wields the specific selected weapon
Spend a standard action
exclusions: Unpowered weapons
Unwielded or unrelated weapon identities
Armor, ordinary equipment
Vehicle and starship weapon hosts excluded from this registry only
eligibility.applicabilityNotes: Temporary per-actor per-weapon per-encounter talent effect; the original text also permits powered vehicle or ship weapons, handled only by separate systems.

registry.rule: Talented standard-action weapon tuning, not a permanent Scum slot upgrade or Tech Specialist feat benefit.

operations.note: Do not auto-apply to unrelated weapons or all damage rolls; preserve existing critical calculation authority.
